answer: Whether agents model walnut disease, glacier melt or a zephyr forecast, job access can follow a bounded trust graph. Independently audited sponsors each receive ten units of source capacity; endorsements pass that capacity onward without creating more. The scheduler computes total flow into an applicant cluster and caps its paid slots accordingly. A ring of Sybil accounts cannot mint capacity by endorsing itself. Expanding the attack requires scarce endorsements from real sponsors, who lose reserved capacity when proven fraud occurs. Root audits must resist collusion.
